key_insight: Under identifiability and regularity conditions, a transformer can estimate ODE parameters from noisy observations and predict trajectories in context without updating its weights.
engineering_relevance: This offers a route to adapting dynamical-system models to new observations without retraining, potentially supporting system identification and forecasting.
method: Use coarse parameter search to initialize within a locally strongly convex region.
Refine estimates with gradient descent as part of approximate maximum likelihood estimation.
Compose the estimator with a neural ODE solution-map approximation, sharing parameters to support both tasks.
evidence_signal: The paper provides nonasymptotic guarantees and finite-pretraining oracle inequalities, while experiments on linear and nonlinear ODEs show benefits from longer inference contexts with fixed weights.
watch_item: The guarantees require identifiability and regularity conditions; practical costs of coarse search and longer contexts need scrutiny.
paper_title: In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs
